description: Everpure, Inc., formerly known as Pure Storage, is a global technology company providing an integrated storage and data management platform, and views data as foundational to its customers' business transformation and increasingly central to their operational resilience and competitive differentiation. It began as a provider of flash-based storage systems and has evolved into a company that delivers a cloud experience with an intelligent, unified storage and data management platform, the Everpure Platform, that virtualizes data across on-premises, hybrid and public cloud, and edge environments into a single storage layer with consistent control, built-in automation and continuous modernization, and it is executing a focused strategy to modernize and simplify data infrastructure for customers as AI adoption increases.
